@description:
 Lore, Stone Lore, Trading Lore This category encompasses the use of
 technical informational and academic skills dealing with relatively common
 topics. Lore skills have a Standard skill bonus progression because is
 assumed that there are common elements to certain “types” Lores. The Lore
 Categories maintain this convention, but the may decide that these skills
 are disparate enough to warrant Combined skill progression. If so, the
 development point costs should be doubled, reflecting the lack of skill
 category ranks.

# ===================================================================
# SKILL DESCRIPTIONS
# ===================================================================

@@ Fauna Lore
@stat: Em
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for recognizing and identifying the animal
 forms within a specific area, region and climate. May be oped either
 in-depth for a specific area or as general education in zoological trends.
 Several different regions/climates may be developed simultaneously,
 provided that research materials are available. This skill may be used for
 learning about specific species providing great detail on the
 characteristics and habits of a particular of animal.

@@ Flora Lore
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for recognizing and identifying the plant forms
 within a specific area, region and climate. May be developed either
 in-depth for a specific area or as general education in flora/botanical
 trends. Several different regions/climates may be developed neously,
 provided that research materials are available. Note: This may be used for
 learning about specific species as well, providing detail on the
 characteristics and habits of a particular type of plant.

@@ Heraldry
@stat: Me
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for designing or recognizing the particular
 heraldic crests (coats-of-arms) specific to a given culture. Separate
 cultures must be developed separately.

@@ History
@stat: Me
@description:
 This skill provides knowledge about the past. One may develop skill in
 general World History (subject to the available learning als—i.e., if
 knowledge about the other side of the world is not available, it may not be
 learned) although the information will be far less specific, focusing
 instead on the broad strokes of history. If this skill is developed in the
 history of a particular region or subject, the information will more
 specific. In essence, the smaller the focus of the skill, the greater level
 of detail and accuracy. Developing skill in the history Kingdom of Harran,
 for instance, might provide information about rulers and the great events
 in the Kingdom's past; skill in the history Guild of Architects in the city
 of Jeppod would likely include all names of the Guild’s officers, the
 bylaws memorized by heart, etc. skill encompasses military history as well.

@@ Philosophy
@stat: In
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for recognizing and identifying aspects of
 philosophic doctrines. Each philosophy doctrine concentrated in and learned
 separately for in-depth knowledge understanding.

@@ Region Lore
@stat: Me
@description:
 This skill provides knowledge about the beliefs, rituals, information about
 a specific region. Note that skill for each region be developed separately.
 All characters begin with ranks in Region for their own region. See Section
 13.0.

@@ Religion
@stat: Me
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for recognizing and identifying aspects of
 religious doctrines. Each religion may be concentrated learned separately
 for in-depth knowledge and understanding. LORE • Magical

@@ Artifact Lore

 This skill provides a bonus for recognizing and knowing the powers potent
 magical items.

@@ Trading Lore
@stat: Me
@description:
 This skill provides knowledge of trade-related affairs. Trade routes,
 customs laws, exchange rates, traditions and rituals, etc. are all
 encompassed by this skill.
